name: Rom
body:
ROM
CR 6

A giant emerges from behind a tree, carrying a massive club. It is dressed in primitive but practical clothing. Upon spotting you it tears a tree from the ground and hefts it as if it were merely a javelin, testing its weight.

XP 2,400
N Huge humanoid (giant)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+10 natural, –2 size)
hp 59 (7d8+28)
Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee greatclub +9 (3d8+6/19–20 bludgeoning)
Ranged tree javalin +14 (2d10+10 piercing, range 60 feet)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 10, Con 18, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +4; CMB +12; CMD 22
Feats Power Attack, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Overrun
Skills Climb +20, Craft (weapons) +5, Handle Animal +5, Heal +5, Perception +11, Survival +11
Languages Common, Giant

ECOLOGY

Environment forests, jungles
Organization solitary, gang (2-5), band (6-8), raiding party (9-12), or tribe (13-30 plus 35% noncombatants plus 1 barbarian or fighter chief of 4th-6th level)
Treasure standard

The rom are massive giants who once were common in the lands of humanity, but they have become far scarcer due to their inability to keep up with human ambition. They mostly subsist in small bands of a dozen as hunter-gatherers and shepherds, living off the land in a relatively uncomplicated existence. Rom are half again as tall and heavy as a hill giant, though their dispositions are far more placid than their more brutish cousins.

While they are generally placid, when the rom are angered, they’ve been known to uproot trees from the ground and throw them like massive javelins at their foes.
